continuation.text:
I left `src/solution.py` unchanged because it already meets the requirements.

- **Feasibility:** it subtracts every request from a copy of the capacities. It returns `False` if a request names an unknown resource or exceeds a capacity.
- **Leftover rule:** after allocation it returns `False` if every resource is fully consumed (all remaining amounts are 0). It returns `True` only when at least one resource has some capacity left. If `resources` is empty, nothing can remain, so it also returns `False`.

I didn't write or run any checks.
